item.title: Weird and Wonderful: 10 Years of Northeast Bottom Longline Survey Video Footage
item.description: Field scientist Hannah Ciarametaro explains how and why the Cooperative Research team collects video footage of the ocean floor during the Gulf of Maine Bottom Longline Survey. She shares the weird and wonderful things they have seen along the way.

item.title: Watch Live: Expedition to Advance Deep-Sea Coral Restoration - NOAA Ocean Exploration
item.description: The upcoming expedition is part of a multi-year collaborative effort to restore deep-sea habitats in the Gulf of Mexico that were injured by the 2010 Deepwater Horizon oil spill, the largest offshore oil spill in U.S. history.
